**Intensive Sea‑Level Outdoor Workout Plan (Coastal Lowlands)**  

| Week | Day | Workout (≈60‑90 min) | Key Focus | Environmental Leverage |

|      | Thu | **Interval Session** – 6 × 800 m at 5‑km pace, 2‑min jog recovery | VO₂max boost | Choose a shaded coastal trail to limit sun exposure; **drink 350‑500 ml / hr** because intervals raise HR [[summaries/session-11_2022-06-15]]. |
|      | Fri | **Strength‑Mobility** – 45 min body‑weight circuit (lunges, push‑ups, plank variations) on the beach | Core & lower‑body strength | The uneven sand challenges stabilisers; keep hydration light (≈300 ml / hr). |
|      | Sat | **Long Run** – 90 min steady at conversational pace, optional tide‑side route | Endurance base | Add **300‑500 mg sodium / hr** if exceeding 90 min (salt capsule or electrolyte drink) [[concepts/hydration_guidelines]]. |
|      | Sun | Rest or gentle yoga | Recovery |  |

| **Weeks 2‑4** – Progression (add 5‑10 % volume or intensity each week) |
|---|
| **Tempo** → 35‑min at tempo; **Intervals** → 8 × 800 m or add 400 m repeats; **Beach sprints** → 6 × 200 m; **Long run** → up to 105 min (maintain ≤ 2 % body‑weight loss). |
| **If/Then Rules** (from [[concepts/if_then_planning]]) |
| • **If** temperature ≥ mid‑70 °F **and** humidity high → aim for the **upper fluid range** (500 ml / hr). |
| • **If** run > 90 min → add **300‑500 mg sodium** for the second hour. |
| • **If** you feel a rising HR at constant effort → sip a quick 50‑ml gulp (under‑hydration cue). |
| • **If** stomach feels “sloshy” → reduce intake to the lower fluid range. |
| **Heat‑Acclimation** (see [[concepts/heat_acclimation]]) |
| • Start week 1 with 30‑min sessions; increase by 10 min each week. |
| • Perform at least **2 × / week** in the warmest part of the day (12‑2 pm) to stimulate adaptation. |
| • Monitor perceived exertion; stay in the “easy‑to‑moderate” zone for the first two weeks, then introduce the harder intervals. |

### Quick Hydration Checklist (run‑time)
| Condition | Fluid (ml / hr) | Sodium (mg / hr) |
|-----------|----------------|-----------------|
| Warm, humid, **easy run** | 300‑350 | none |
| Warm, humid, **tempo / interval** | 350‑500 | 0‑300 (if < 90 min) |
| > 90 min **steady/long run** | 400‑500 | 300‑500 |
| **Beach sand circuit** | 300‑400 (short bursts) | optional 300 mg if > 45 min |

#### How this plan exploits the coastal low‑land setting
* **Flat, windy boardwalks** let you run fast while the breeze helps dissipate heat.  
* **Sand & shallow water** provide natural resistance and rapid cooling, improving plyometric strength without needing equipment.  
* **Tide‑influenced routes** introduce variable surface hardness, training proprioception and leg‑muscle endurance.  

Follow the **if/then** hydration rules and the **heat‑acclimation** progression to stay safe and maximize performance.
